summary: Forward Harbour was a former cannery town on the Central Coast of British Columbia, Canada, in the Johnstone Strait region. It sits on the inlet of the same name, on the mainland side of Wellbore Channel, east of Hardwicke Island. The note also places nearby Jackson Bay and Heydon Bay, which front on other bodies of water.
one_line: Forward Harbour is a former cannery town on the mainland side of Wellbore Channel in British Columbia's Central Coast.
key_facts: Forward Harbour was a cannery town in the Johnstone Strait region of the Central Coast of British Columbia, Canada.
Forward Harbour is located on the inlet of the same name.
Forward Harbour's inlet is on the mainland side of Wellbore Channel.
Forward Harbour is located to the east of Hardwicke Island.
Jackson Bay lies to the immediate north of Forward Harbour, off Sunderland Channel.
Jackson Bay is in the same vicinity on the Mainland as Forward Harbour but fronts on a different body of water.
Heydon Bay, British Columbia lies to the east on Loughborough Inlet.
Heydon Bay is in the same vicinity on the Mainland as Forward Harbour but fronts on a different body of water.
